title: Chapter 433 The Pride Of The Human Emperor Palace
content:
Chapter 433 The Pride Of The Human Emperor Palace

"Since I have completed the task assigned by the little master, I can go back."

"Hiss, the war is coming, and I'm really a little uneasy to stay outside."

Ao Qing muttered, shook his body and prepared to return.

Seeing Ao Qing just said a few words, Bai Ling on the side couldn't help but feel a little worried.

"Mr. Aoqing, are we going back now?"

Hearing Bai Ling's words, Ao Qing asked back, "Or why are you still here?"

"Oh? You are not reluctant to go back when you are back, are you?"

Ao Qing looked at Bai Ling and chuckled, "If you don't want to go back, I won't say anything. This is your freedom."

Ao Qing's words made Bai Ling's face pale, and he waved his hand and said, "No, Lord Ao Qing, it's not that I don't want to go back, it's just, just,"

And just then, the patriarch of the Tian Yao tribe hurriedly said, "Mr. Aoqing, you don't have to be so anxious to go back."

"Hmm? Are you still in trouble?"

Ao Qing turned his head and looked at the leader of the Tian Yao clan.

The head of the Tian Yao tribe coughed lightly, rubbed his hands and said, "Mr. Aoqing, now that the Chaos Realm is coming outside, our Chaos Realm must be united, right?"

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing nodded slightly and said, "Yes."

The head of the Tiande Clan's Clan's smile became a little stronger, and he continued, "Since that's the case, as long as my Tiande Clan can increase its strength, it will be a good thing for the entire Chaos Realm. Do you think so?"

Ao Qing looked at the leader of the Tian Yao Clan for a while and asked, "Do you want to?"

I saw that the leader of the Tiande Clan knelt on one knee and said respectfully to Ao Qing: "Please stay in the Tiande Clan and lead my Tiande Clan. You have the pure Tiande bloodline. I believe, Tiande Under your leadership, the clan's strength will inevitably rise rapidly."

"In addition, the Four Elephants of the Heavenly Demon, White Tiger, has been found, right in the Huangcheng City. I hope Miss Bai Ling can go to Huangcheng City, reunite with the other three Four Elephants, and practice the Four Elephants magical powers of the Heavenly Demon!"

The patriarch of the Tian Yao clan said sincerely, lowered his head slightly, feeling a little nervous.

Bai Ling was immediately excited when he heard this.

If my brother is in the deserted city, then I will be able to see my brother immediately.

Thinking of this, Bai Ling began to look forward to it.

Ao Qing was silent, allowing the Heavenly Demon Clan to quickly improve his strength in a short period of time. He naturally had that ability, but he felt it was a bit troublesome.

What to do, whether to stay or not.

Ao Qing hesitated a little, so he closed his eyes, but then Lu Xue's slightly sad face appeared in his mind.

The connection between him and Lu Xue was extremely deep, and he felt something about Lu Xue's thoughts.

Facing the Land of Gods, Lu Xue was really worried without the help of her master.

Thinking of this, Ao Qing sighed slightly.

Well, then work hard on yourself.

"Okay, I will stay in the Heavenly Demon Clan these days."

Ao Qing spoke softly, which immediately made the leader of the Tiande Clan ecstatic.

"Thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you!"

"but,,"

Ao Qing's face suddenly turned slightly cold, and the head of the Tiande Clan suddenly felt a slap in his heart. Could it be that he was going to bleed heavily? However, what is the point of being able to keep Lord Ao Qing in the Tiande Clan?

"Mr. Aoqing speaks, no matter what the conditions are, the Tian Yao Clan will satisfy you!"

Ao Qing narrowed his eyes slightly and said quietly: "It is necessary to eat and drink every day. It is best to find a few young and beautiful little dragon girls to sing and dance to cheer up."

Ga~

The leader of the Tiande Clan was a little dumbfounded, Bai Ling was stunned, and the other powerful people of the Tiande Clan were speechless.

"This, this, this,"

The Heavenly Demon Clan wanted to break his head but didn't expect that Ao Qing would put forward such conditions.

Could it be that all the strong people in this realm are so happy?

"What, no?"

Ao Qing looked unkind and said, "I'm not kind."

"OK!"

The patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan quickly agreed, "Don't worry, Lord Ao Qing, we will definitely satisfy you!"

As he said that, the patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan ordered his subordinates to prepare as soon as possible.

"Mr. Aoqing, then I,"

Bai Ling stepped forward and said weakly.

Ao Qing is currently in a happy fantasy, and he is about to fight. Can't enjoy it anymore?

Hearing Bai Ling's words, Ao Qing glanced at Bai Ling lightly and said in a low voice: "You go back to the deserted city alone. After seeing the little master, go find the three symbols."

"When you meet the little master, you should know what to say."

Bai Ling nodded: "Lord Ao Qing stayed in the Heavenly Demon Clan to help the Heavenly Demon Clan accumulate strength in preparation for a war soon."

"Yes." Ao Qing nodded with satisfaction, "You go."

"Yes, Lord Ao Qing said goodbye."

"The patriarch said goodbye."

After Bai Ling said hello, he turned into a Vermillion Bird and spread his wings away.

On the other side, in the Human Emperor Hall.

Wu Hui's face was calm, looking at the two young figures in front of him, one man and one woman.

"The list of geniuses has been opened, and it is time for our Human Emperor Palace to show its power."

"Go and let the world see how dazzling the genius of my Human Imperial Palace is."

The two of them clasped their fists and looked firm, "Don't worry, Lord Lord, you will not be embarrassed by the Human Emperor Palace."

Wu Hui nodded slightly and ordered, "Mochou, you will escort these two little guys."

After the voice fell, Mo Chou's figure appeared in the hall. He smiled softly, his face always with a confident smile: "I am willing to serve."

When they saw that Mo Chou was escorting them to the list, they were immediately excited.

Mochou is the closest subordinate of the Palace Master. It seems that the Palace Master attaches great importance to him.

Until outside the hall, both of them were inexplicably excited.

At this time, Mo Chou said angrily: "Don't fantasize about you two, the Palace Master's ace is not you two little guys."

Mochou looked back at the Human Emperor Palace, his eyes were bright, and he whispered, "That little monster, but he hasn't come out of seclusion yet."

Hearing the three words "Little Monster", the two obviously trembled, and it was obvious that they had some shadows.

After a little silence, the young man said first: "Senior Mochou, I will win the top ten and be the one with a face in the Human Emperor Palace."

"Top ten, haha, is it just the top ten?"

The boy gritted his teeth, "Top five!"

The girl next to her opened her mouth slightly, with a little surprise in her bright eyes.

"Gong Ting, you are so awesome."

The girl gave a thumbs up at the boy.

The boy's face suddenly turned slightly red.

Mochou shook his head and said, "Xingcai, don't laugh at a person with ambition."

Hearing this, the girl waved her hand quickly: "I didn't laugh at her, and I also think Gong Ting is definitely in the top five."

"Really?"

Gong Ting asked with some surprise.

The girl looked serious, "That's natural."

The boy looked at the girl's pretty face for a long time and suddenly smiled, "Xingcai, when we meet, I will not show mercy anymore."

Hearing this, the girl turned her head, stroked the broken hair in her ears, and responded softly, "Okay, one word is certain."

Looking at the handsome couple, Mo Chou shook his head and smiled, "I won't say anything, I'll leave."
